notes.silhouette: Recognizable tall stepped spiral, flared aperture, broad shield and long opposed blade, low stance. Side/back shell volume credible; shell is more upright and planar at lip than the reference.
notes.face: Broad salmon brow and cheek mask, stalk eyes and pointed mandibles clearly read as a full face. More symmetrical and beak-like than the organic reference; dark breast stack remains visually dense.
notes.details: Cream/coral shell bands, burgundy articulated limbs, amber slit eyes and asymmetric weapons carry the approved identity. Shoulders read as armor blocks; breast framing is angular and crowded but coherent.
notes.facet: Broad shell planes and smaller limb facets make a coherent low-poly hierarchy. Some long lip planes and dark recess triangles feel less deliberately composed than the original.
